cards.title: Weft
cards.sub: Coordination at edit time, for many agents on one codebase. Built on Cloudflare.

cards.title: Git coordinates at merge time. Agents need edit time.
lines: branch → work for a day → pull request → conflict found
10 agents · same function · same minute · own checkouts
branches merge cleanly — and do not compile
every edit checked against the others while it is written

cards.title: One ordered log per repo. Diagnostics back into the agent.
lines: Claude Code · Codex · OpenCode · Hermes · file watcher
native hooks → WCP: check before the edit, commit after
one Durable Object per repo: order, validate, arbitrate
allow · warn · deny, with the cause and the other side's diff

cards.title: Both callers keep working
lines: export function createSession(userId: string, opts: SessionOptions): Session;

cards.title: 43 seconds, no human
lines: revert deployed · GET /quote → 200 · task reopened with the stack trace

cards.title: What a harness can do
lines: file watcher: report edits after the fact, gate commits
deny an edit before it touches disk
refuse to finish while an error is open

cards.quote: “…agents, commands, hooks, rules, and user-interface extensions. These concepts do not yet have consistent semantics or security models across clients, so they are not portable component types in 1.0.”

lines: repos, forks, previews straight from a commit
agents and git, no secrets inside
